The diameter \(AB\) divides the disk into two semicircles, so the angles above \(AB\) sum to \(180^\circ\).

The shaded sector has central angle \(x\). The upper semicircle is split into angles
\[
40^\circ+x+50^\circ+30^\circ=180^\circ.
\]
Thus
\[
x=180^\circ-120^\circ=60^\circ.
\]

For a uniform point in the disk, the probability is proportional to area. A sector with central angle \(x\) occupies \(\frac{x}{360^\circ}\) of the whole disk. Therefore
\[
P=\frac{60}{360}=\frac16.
\]
